T1_status.decision: NOT CONVERTED INTO SECURITY ACCEPTANCE. This stage ships NO production-owned sealed constructor entrypoint.
T1_status.why: HQ247-T1 permits EITHER building a production-owned sealed entrypoint under HQ242 T1 OR rigorously specifying it. Building one would require production P07 mutation and a production callsite, which this commission's permitted write terrain forbids ('No accepted production P07/F7'). Fabricating a 'sealed' entrypoint inside the quarantined module and calling it trusted provenance would be exactly the 'assumed test TCB converted into security acceptance' the commission prohibits.
T1_status.what_is_actually_honoured: the caller-selected callables remain ASSUMED TRUSTED. The native owner pins their identities in C at construction, never re-reads them from a caller-visible attribute, deep validates and deep copies all caller data before any trusted call, and never consults the live registry or the Python owner for a positive. That is TCB ASSUMPTION, recorded as such, not TCB PROOF.
T1_status.fake_callback_attack_tested: test_b2_positive_authority_callback_receives_a_positional_tuple substitutes a SPY for require_positive_authority and shows the native owner calls exactly the pinned object with exactly the documented convention. This demonstrates the seam is honoured, NOT that the pinned object is trustworthy.
T1_status.rebind_resistance_retained: test_d7_rebinding_the_p07_module_attribute_does_not_change_pinned_seam (HQ246 court) still holds: rebinding rawlsing_next.pre553_empirical_objects.semantic_hash after construction cannot change the replay identity or custody hash the native owner produces.
T1_status.arbitrary_trusted_executable_replacement: T2, explicitly OUT OF SCOPE and not attempted
T1_status.handover: a rigorous specification for the production-owned sealed constructor is the correct deliverable of a FUTURE commission that is allowed to touch production. It is recorded here as required-by-specification, not implemented.
T1_status.spec_sketch: a production module would own module-private sealed constants for semantic_hash, canonicalize and require_positive_authority, expose exactly one construction entrypoint that pins those private constants and refuses any caller-supplied callable, and be imported only by production P07. Until then no native owner may be treated as an authority.
